queries.sql: SELECT join_date, age_band FROM app.customer_profile LIMIT 1;

SELECT card_ref, product_id, product_name, brand, issue_date, current_status, product_effective_date, is_product_effective_on_base_date, annual_fee FROM app.customer_cards ORDER BY card_ref LIMIT 200;
SELECT card_ref, month, period_start, period_end, approved_amount, transaction_count FROM app.monthly_usage ORDER BY month DESC, card_ref LIMIT 200;

queries.description: 기준일 이전 완료월의 최신 연체 현황 조회
queries.sql: SELECT base_month, as_of_date, overdue_amount, overdue_days, overdue_count_12m FROM app.customer_delinquency ORDER BY base_month DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT card_ref, month, period_start, period_end, merchant_name, category, first_approved_date, last_approved_date, approved_amount, transaction_count FROM app.merchant_usage ORDER BY month DESC, approved_amount DESC, card_ref, merchant_name, category LIMIT 200;
SELECT base_month, as_of_date, overdue_amount, overdue_days, overdue_count_12m FROM app.customer_delinquency_history ORDER BY base_month DESC LIMIT 12;
SELECT usage_date, approved_amount, transaction_count FROM app.customer_daily_usage ORDER BY usage_date DESC LIMIT 90;

queries.description: 활성 카드별 자료상 연회비와 최근 6개월 승인 사용액
queries.sql:
SELECT
    card_ref,
    product_name,
    brand,
    product_effective_date,
    is_product_effective_on_base_date,
    listed_annual_fee,
    usage_period_start,
    usage_period_end,
    approved_amount_6m,
    transaction_count_6m,
    covered_month_count,
    active_month_count
FROM app.card_fee_usage_6m
WHERE current_status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY listed_annual_fee DESC, approved_amount_6m ASC, card_ref
LIMIT 20;
